if_tail_were_incorrectly_treated_as_full.note: These impossible-looking values expose the uncharged retained reconstruction.

free_objects_in_spectral_screen: exact reconstruction of the retained rank-764 component

followup_decision.claim_boundary: This invalidates promotion of this SVD-tail screen and rejects the tested NanoQuant-style factorization; it is not an impossibility proof for every learned or procedural basis codec.
followup_decision.reason: The only apparent >=target signal was the uncharged tail ratio. The more favorable rate-accounted continuous Stiefel/Gram oracle already falls to F=0.95049, and the charged discrete binary-factor test (when supplied) is much worse.

binary_factor.claim_boundary: Sampled tiles and NumPy LB-ADMM/SVID port; not full-panel encoded MSE and not a bitstream. FP16 scales and binary factor bits are physically ledgered.

metric_and_jacobian_audit.differential: dW = U dSigma V^T + dU Sigma V^T + U Sigma dV^T, after quotienting the joint signed/rotational gauge
metric_and_jacobian_audit.embedded_volume_element: for distinct nonzero singular values, the SVD Jacobian contains products of powers of sigma_i and |sigma_i^2-sigma_j^2|; the tail-only score charges neither this volume nor chart precision
metric_and_jacobian_audit.frobenius_metric: basis perturbations are multiplied by Sigma; within-subspace rotations couple singular directions, so equal parameter error does not imply equal W-space MSE

rate_accounted_comparator.model: H = c I + A_k, with source-specific symmetric rank-k A_k, followed by exact polar Q
optimism: ideal asymptotic Gaussian RD for both components
no finite-block, curvature, chart, index, scale, alignment, or decoder penalty
the primary cross-method decision gives shared tables for free
rate_accounted_comparator.scoring: Exact orthogonal model/normal energies are assigned to exact dimensions, then both receive an ideal Gaussian reverse-waterfill. F=D/2^(-2R), s=-0.5log2(F).

why_leave_one_out_does_not_repair_it: LOO cross-fitting protects selection of representation/scaling/rank, but each held-out matrix is still decomposed into its own exact U, V, and singular values at zero transmitted rate.
